title: Painter suing Bill Belichick for nearly $300,000 over alleged ‘serious’ injuries suffered at his home

sources.title: Painter suing Bill Belichick for nearly $300,000 over alleged ‘serious’ injuries suffered at his home
sources.description: The limited liability company registered to North Carolina head coach Bill Belichick has been sued for more than $285,000 by a painter.
